_comment: DEV MCP config for roles that need a visible Chrome with human-takeover (web_designer, tester). Adds Auto Browser MCP on top of the standard org MCP. Auto Browser exposes its tools over HTTP at 127.0.0.1:8000/mcp; we attach via the stdio bridge that ships with the repo at /Users/gob/Projects/auto-browser/scripts/mcp_stdio_bridge.py.
